text: Session date: 2026-10-12 (the local date when Part B started; <the session date> below = 2026-10-12). Source: the user's launch message of 2026-10-12, Part C, quoted verbatim:
=== PART C: THE sd2 SESSION (only if Part B passed) ===
I authorise exactly this, once:
1. Snapshot first: the sd2 snapshot tool to D:/BattleShip_source_snapshots/<the session date>_m8_sd2, verified by the tool and by the independent PowerShell re-hash (A5).

2. Approval second: tools/m8_sd2/write_approval.py, quoting this Part C authorisation verbatim with the session date in its authorisation file, writing the new docs/rl_m8_sd2_approval.json. From here until the launch, the no-commit rule applies.
3. The full preflight, ONCE. If it fails for any reason, stop; do not re-run it.

4. One detached session via tools/m8_sd2/launch_detached.ps1 (A5). Run check_launch.py within two minutes (A8). Then wait with tools/m8_sd2/wait_session.py --session sd2 (default 3.5 h); any non-zero exit is a stop (A7). Do not close the terminal that launched it. No retries, extensions, repairs, and NO sd3.
5. Afterwards:
- verify-run and report to logs/m8_sd2_run/, then tools/m8_sd2/copy_launch_evidence.py --session sd2 (only stamped JSON into launch/ and derived/).

- Back up runs/m8_rd_sd2 to D:/BattleShip_runs_backup/<the session date>_incr_m8_rd_sd2 (A1) with runs_backup.py, then tools/m8_sd2/post_run_checks.py --session sd2 --tool-verify (the tool verify with --source runs/m8_rd_sd2 on that folder only, the independent re-hash of every increment, R1 over the five earlier M8 trees, coverage 0 uncovered).

- Write the results record as a new file named exactly docs/rl_m8_sd2_results_<YYYY-MM-DD>.md (the session date). Its FIRST line must be "# M8-sd2 results (<same date>)", a "##" section must follow, and the file must end with a newline; check it with check-results-record. Write no draft or other file whose name starts with rl_m8_sd2_results. Include the A1 and A10 statements.
All absolute constraints apply. In particular:
- No native RNG seed inspection, logging, control, comparison or hashing.
- Process restart resets the episode.
- The exact submit/consume/input tick contract.
- Canonical controller words as replay truth, with no hidden actions.
- The routes used are the agent's own.
- Human recordings and the TAS are validation-only and never read.
- No hardcoded routes or waypoints.
- Non-PORT decomp/byte-matching behaviour is preserved.
